checkMessages: Exactly one available non-drive MTP device selected; no ambiguous device choice.
Original disposable connection folder is accessible after physical reconnect.
Original Reconnect.txt retains exact pre-disconnection bytes after physical reconnect.
Production explorer opens the retained disposable folder and lists its probe after physical reconnect.
captureMethod: RenderTargetBitmap of visible production WPF windows
interaction: Live MTP connection acceptance; individual checks identify the executed path. A resumed session only reads the original disposable probe after physical reconnection.
limitations: Disconnect occurs while idle, not during a transfer. One device only; no cross-device or ADB test. Device IDs are not retained.
